leakage.reason: Result names 'rheumatoid factor' (a gold word as part of a standard test name); the test is negative and does not name the diagnosis.

source_issues: The diagnostic reasoning mentions three sets of aerobic and anaerobic cultures and one set of fungal and mycobacterial culture; the prompt calls all of them blood cultures.
notes: Index visit: the outpatient presentation with 6 months of progressive right hip and groin pain (s001, s002, s004, s005, s007), with the staged workup that followed; results from later visits carry time where the prompt gives it (repeat radiographs 5 months later; swollen joint count on subsequent visits).
x005 aliases include 'rheumatoid factor' (check_coverage warns: gold word in a finding alias): it is the clinical name of the test and is kept so the request can be matched; the warning is accepted.
Leg-length discrepancy and limited hip motion are examination measurements and stay in the findings; ulnar deviation is reported only on the hand radiographs, so it is not a patient fact.

excluded_sentences.reason: 'Over 5 months she became unable to ambulate': read as progression during the 5-month workup (the repeat radiographs 5 months later show complete femoral head destruction), i.e. course after the index visit. If it instead describes the 6 months before presentation, it would be a patient fact (unable to walk).
